source.note: Charles printed p52/PDF90, XXI.1 only. Opening verb read as ዖድኩ, supported by actual Dillmann 1865 cols999-1000 journey/circuit range; Charles p52 note21 itself flags the rare journey sense. No canonical English used.

translation.text: I traveled on to a place where nothing had been made.

source.text: *ወበህየ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ግብረ፡ ግሩመ፤ ርኢኩ፡ ወኢሰማየ፡ ላዕለ፡ ወኢምድረ፡ ሥርርት፡ አላ፡ መካነ፡ ዘአኮ፡ ድልወ፡ ወ*ግሩም።
source.note: Charles p52/PDF90, XXI.2 only. Both negatives ወኢሰማየ and ወኢምድረ are preserved; not the inherited OCR positive-looking forms. Firm/founded range checked in actual Dillmann col238; unprepared reading follows selected text, including Charles editorial constitution noted at p52 note30. Asterisks retained as edition signs, not verse text.

translation.text: There I saw a terrifying sight. I saw neither heaven above nor earth firmly established, but an unprepared and terrifying place.

source.text: ወህየ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ሰብዐተ፡ ከዋክብተ፡ ሰማይ፡ እሱራነ፡ በሕቡር፡ †ተጋሩ፡† ከመ፡ አድባር፡ ዐበይት፡ ወበእሳት፡ እንዘ፡ ይነዱ።
source.note: Charles p52->p54/PDF90->92. Selected daggered token transcribed provisionally as ተጋሩ; the source is not silently replaced with inherited OCR ኅቡረ. The independent በሕቡር conveys together. Charles p52 note37 discusses corruption and alternative explanations. I cannot securely render the additional daggered term; English literal uncertainty retained and row held, rather than silently omit the term or import a later translation.

transcription_uncertainties.location: Charles p52/PDF90, XXI.3 daggered token before ከመ
transcription_uncertainties.issue: Selected edition marks corruption; secure English sense of this extra token is not established by this author.
transcription_uncertainties.treatment: No conjectural replacement; English ⟦?⟧ marks unresolved term; HOLD.

translation.text: There I saw seven stars of heaven bound together, ⟦?⟧ like great mountains, and burning in fire.

footnotes.text: The selected Ethiopic edition marks a word here as corrupt. Its secure meaning has not been established in this author packet; ⟦?⟧ preserves that unresolved term. This row is held, not publication-ready.

source.text: ወእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ እቤ፡ በእንተ፡ አይ፡ ኀጢአት፡ ተአስሩ፡ ወበእንተ፡ ምንት፡ ዝየ፡ ተገድፉ።
source.note: Charles p54/PDF92, complete XXI.4. Sin/offence, binding and leaving checked against actual Dillmann cols621,747,1205. Question construction rendered as direct speech; no extra substantive motive added.

translation.text: Then I said, “For what sin were they bound, and why were they left here?”

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ ኡርኤል፡ ፩*እምቅዱሳን፡ መላእክት፡ ዘምስሌየ፡ ወእቱ፡ ዘይመርሐኒ፡ ወይቤ፤ ሄኖክ፡ በእንተ፡ መኑ፡ ትስእል፡ ወበእንተ፡ መኑ፡ ትጠይቅ፡ ወትጽህቅ።
source.note: Charles p54/PDF92, XXI.5. The asking/inquiring/zeal construction is rendered in two natural English questions, retaining the personal interrogative. Actual Dillmann cols375-376,1245-1246,1254-1255 used for lexical ranges. Selected text says guide-me; Charles note9 proposes a different reading with Greek, which is not silently adopted.

translation.text: Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me and guided me, said to me, “Enoch, whom are you asking about? About whom are you inquiring so eagerly?”

footnotes.text: The Ethiopic combines asking, inquiring and eager concern; the English compresses the latter two into “inquiring so eagerly.” The selected guide-me reading is retained rather than silently adopting Charles’s proposed alternative.

source.text: እሉ፡ ወእቶሙ፡ እምነ፡ ከዋክብት፡ እለ፡ ኀለፉ፡ ትእዛዘ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ወተአስሩ፡ በዝየ፡ እስከ፡ ሶበ፡ ይትፈጸም፡ ትእልፊተ፡ ዓም፡ ⟦?⟧ልቈ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኀጢአቶሙ።
source.note: Charles p54/PDF92 only, XXI.6. Exact original obstacle remains: consonantal AND vocalic identity of the FIRST selected fidel of inherited ኈልቈ. I cannot certify it; modern POB transcription marker ⟦?⟧ replaces that one fidel only. It is not a printed lacuna, ancient omission, or claim that the chapter is incomplete. Actual Dillmann cols575-577 number/count,721 myriad and955 year support possible semantics, not Charles glyph identity. Charles p54 note18 explicitly emends ዓም with Greek ἔτη from ዓለም: ten thousand years is a selected-edition Greek-assisted emendation, not an unqualified Ethiopic manuscript reading. Actual edited Dillmann1851 PDF19/printed13->PDF20/printed14 was personally compared, but no word was adopted as an additional English input; I could not certify its exact first fidel sufficiently to freeze that critical alternative. English count-word uncertainty is preserved, not filled by narrative expectation.

transcription_uncertainties.location: Charles p54/PDF92, XXI.6 count word immediately after ዓም and before መዋዕለ
transcription_uncertainties.scope: ONE first fidel, both consonantal identity and vocalic order
transcription_uncertainties.issue: Previously submitted ኈ not certified from actual selected Charles print.
transcription_uncertainties.treatment: No normalization or count-context inference. Literal marker retained. HOLD.
transcription_uncertainties.not_claimed: No ancient lacuna, no MSS certification, no selected-English count-word adoption.

transcription_uncertainties.issue: Explicit emendation with Greek ἔτη from ዓለም.
transcription_uncertainties.treatment: English years follows the selected critical edition with indispensable internal explanation, not a new translator emendation.

translation.text: These are among the stars that transgressed the command of God. They have been bound here until ten thousand years are completed, ⟦?⟧ of the days of their sin.

footnotes.text: The first Ethiopic letter of the count word remains unresolved in the selected Charles scan. The count word is therefore left ⟦?⟧ here; the row is held. “Years” follows Charles’s explicit emendation of ዓለም with Greek ἔτη in p54 note18; it is not an independently established Ethiopic manuscript reading.

source.text: ወእምህየ፡ ሖርኩ፡ ካልአ፡ መካነ፡ እምዝ፡ ዘይገርም፡ ወርኢኩ፡ ግብረ፡ ግሩመ፤ እሳት፡ ዐቢይ፡ በህየ፡ ዘይነድድ፡ ወያንበለብል፡ ወ*መምተርተ፡ ቦቱ፡ መካኑ፡ እስከ፡ ቀላይ፡ ፍጹም፡ አዕማደ፡ እሳት፡ ዐበይተ፡ ዘይወርድዎሙ፡ ወኢ*እምጣኖ፡ ወኢ*ዕበዮ፡ ኢክህልኩ፡ ነጽሮ፡ ወስእነኩ፡ [ነጽሮ፡] ዐይኖ።
source.note: Charles p54/PDF92, entire XXI.7. Actual Dillmann cols185 cutting/chasm,415 abyss,649-650 blaze,957 pillar,701-703 seeing/estimating and377 inability checked. ፍጹም treated adverbially with reach to the abyss, not made an unsupported geological claim that the abyss is bottomless. Actual bracketed repeated ነጽሮ is retained in source; Charles note39 calls it an intrusion, and English avoids duplicating a seeing verb. English descent pronoun refers to the chasm/abyss; review that compression against selected syntax.

translation.text: From there I went to another place, more terrifying than this, and saw a terrifying sight: a great fire burning and blazing there. The place had a chasm reaching all the way to the abyss, with great pillars of fire descending into it. I could see neither its extent nor its size, nor could I estimate it.

footnotes.text: Charles brackets a repeated seeing verb as an intrusion (p54 note39). The English renders the seeing/estimating sequence without reproducing that repetition.

source.text: ወእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ እቤ፡ እፎ፡ ግሩም፡ ዝንቱ፡ መካን፡ ወሕሙም፡ ለነጽር።
source.note: Charles p54/PDF92, complete XXI.8. Painful/afflictive, not merely magnificent: actual Dillmann cols71-72 and Charles p54 note41 control ሕሙም. English retains both terror and painful sight.

translation.text: Then I said, “How terrifying this place is, and how painful to look at!”

footnotes.text: The selected Ethiopic describes the place as painful or afflictive to look at, in addition to terrifying.

source.text: ወእተ፡ ጊዜ፡ አውሥአኒ፡ ኡርኤል፡ ፩*እምቅዱሳን፡ መላእክት፡ እንዘ፡ ምስሌየ፡ ሀሎ፡ ወይቤለኒ፡ ሄኖክ፡ ምንተ፡ ፈራህከ፡ ከመዝ፡ ወደንገፅከ፡ ወአውሥአኩ፡ በእንተዝ፡ ግሩም፡ መካን፡ ወቅድመ፡ ገጸ፡ *ስቃየ፡ ሕማም።
source.note: Charles p54->p56/PDF92->94, entire XXI.9, not clipped at page92 after Enoch. Exact continuation includes question, first-person reply and painful-torment phrase. Charles p56 note4 and p55 note46 explicitly restore/reposition ወአውሥአኩ as first-person answer; that selected-edition restoration is disclosed, not claimed to be uniform manuscript evidence. Actual Dillmann cols1119 fear/dismay,1351 fear,461-462 causal/front range,1208-1210 face/sight and247-248 torment checked. Painful torment renders the construct combination; not an invented second torture scene.

translation.text: Then Uriel, one of the holy angels who was with me, answered me and said, “Enoch, why are you so afraid and dismayed?” I answered, “Because of this terrifying place and the sight of painful torment.”

footnotes.text: The selected edition restores the first-person “I answered” here by repositioning a transmitted word (Charles p55 note46 and p56 note4). The English follows that disclosed editorial restoration.

source.text: ወይቤለኒ፡ ዝመካን፡ ቤተ፡ ሞቅሖሙ፡ ለመላእክት፡ ወህየ፡ ይትአሐዙ፡ እስከ፡ ለዓለም።
source.note: Charles p56/PDF94, numbered10 ends before XXII. Prison term checked against actual Dillmann cols909-910; selected ወህየ is rendered there, not silently normalized to here. This author independently reassesses the displayed source; inherited claims of earlier acceptance are not a substitute for this pass or later distinct review.

translation.text: He said to me, “This place is the prison of the angels, and there they will be held forever.”
